statements.__comment: CIDR blocks of peer VPC stubs that no peering reported in this run. A stub has no arn, no owning account and nothing but peerings and CIDR blocks attached. Skipped while another account's peering still references the stub; that account's cleanup removes it.
statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(:AWSVpc)<-[:ACCEPTER_VPC|REQUESTER_VPC]-(:AWSPeeringConnection)-[r:ACCEPTER_CIDR|REQUESTER_CIDR]->(n:AWSCidrBlock)<-[:BLOCK_ASSOCIATION]-(v:AWSVpc) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG AND v.arn IS NULL AND NOT (v)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount) AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (v)-[x]-() WHERE NOT type(x) IN ['ACCEPTER_VPC', 'REQUESTER_VPC', 'BLOCK_ASSOCIATION'] } AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (n)<-[ro:ACCEPTER_CIDR|REQUESTER_CIDR]-(:AWSPeeringConnection) WHERE ro.lastupdated = $UPDATE_TAG } AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (v)<-[:ACCEPTER_VPC|REQUESTER_VPC]-(o:AWSPeeringConnection) WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (o)-[:ACCEPTER_VPC|REQUESTER_VPC]->(:AWSVpc)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID}) } } WITH DISTINCT n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: Peer VPC stubs referenced only by this account's stale peerings, with their CIDR blocks. Runs before the stale peerings are deleted, because they are the path to the stubs.
statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(:AWSVpc)<-[:ACCEPTER_VPC|REQUESTER_VPC]-(p:AWSPeeringConnection)-[:ACCEPTER_VPC|REQUESTER_VPC]->(v:AWSVpc) WHERE p.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG AND v.arn IS NULL AND NOT (v)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount) AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (v)-[x]-() WHERE NOT type(x) IN ['ACCEPTER_VPC', 'REQUESTER_VPC', 'BLOCK_ASSOCIATION'] } AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (v)<-[:ACCEPTER_VPC|REQUESTER_VPC]-(o:AWSPeeringConnection) WHERE o.lastupdated = $UPDATE_TAG OR NOT EXISTS { MATCH (o)-[:ACCEPTER_VPC|REQUESTER_VPC]->(:AWSVpc)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID}) } } WITH DISTINCT v LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE OPTIONAL MATCH (v)-[:BLOCK_ASSOCIATION]->(c:AWSCidrBlock) DETACH DELETE c, v return COUNT(DISTINCT v) as TotalCompleted

MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(:AWSVpc)<-[:ACCEPTER_VPC]-(n:AWSPeeringConnection) WHERE n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(:AWSVpc)<-[:REQUESTER_VPC]-(n:AWSPeeringConnection) WHERE n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
